CONTEXTO / DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em Fortaleza, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA

O/a Supervisor Operacional será responsável pela operacionalização em campo do Projeto em Fortaleza, realizando a gestão da equipe e dos indicadores de desempenho. Para tanto, atuará em apoio e organização das atividades dos promotores sociais, agentes e atendentes comunitários.

PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Supervisionar as atividades de campo da equipe dentro da metodologia dos projetos;
  2. Realizar a caracterização e diagnóstico do território – prospecção territorial/metodologia SEECA;
  3. Acolher, discutir e realizar encaminhamentos das demandas pertinentes a visita;
  4. Realizar o registro das informações e produção de evidências sob autorização (conforme LGPD);
  5. Preencher relatórios de acompanhamento das visitas e encaminhar para a área demandante com os acompanhamentos referente às áreas;
  6. Realizar viagens para acompanhamento das atividades da equipe, quando necessário;
  7. Proceder com o acompanhamento geral de todos os indicadores e metas do projeto, elaborando estudos analíticos e relatórios de desempenho;
  8. Controlar o estoque dos materiais utilizados na operação e realizar a logística de reposição;
  9. Asegurar o treinamento das equipes sob sua gestão, qualificando e desenvolvendo competências, objetivando incrementar os padrões de segurança, qualidade, produtividade e acompanhar o desempenho funcional das equipes de trabalho, avaliando comportamento e motivação;
  10. Realizar os Diálogos de Segurança mensais, em alinhamento com as diretrizes do setor de SST da Matriz;
  11. Sugerir para a Gerência matérias ou notícias para fins de divulgação nos canais institucionais da organização, apoiando nos devidos registros;
  12. Controlar a jornada de trabalho da sua equipe mensalmente, acompanhando faltas, entregas de atestados, banco de horas e montagem de escala, se necessário;
  13. Apoiar a elaboração do planejamento de férias da equipe em cumprimento das diretrizes legais, visando não haver prejuízo nas atividades do projeto;
  14. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  15. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  16. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do Projeto.

Descrição do Cargo:

O Eletrotécnico é responsável por realizar atividades relacionadas à instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas elétricos. Esses profissionais possuem conhecimentos técnicos em eletricidade e estão capacitados para trabalhar com circuitos elétricos, equipamentos e dispositivos elétricos. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

  1. Instalação elétrica: Realizar a instalação de sistemas elétricos em edifícios, residências, indústrias e outras estruturas, seguindo normas e regulamentações técnicas. Isso inclui a instalação de fiação, cabos, painéis elétricos, disjuntores, tomadas e interruptores.
  2. Manutenção preventiva e corretiva: Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em sistemas elétricos para garantir o seu funcionamento adequado e a segurança dos usuários. Isso envolve a inspeção, limpeza, ajuste, reparo e substituição de componentes, como disjuntores, fusíveis, conexões e sistemas de aterramento.
  3. Diagnóstico de falhas: Identificar e diagnosticar problemas em sistemas elétricos por meio de testes, medições e análise técnica. Utilizar instrumentos de medição, como multímetros, para verificar a voltagem, corrente e resistência nos circuitos, a fim de localizar e solucionar falhas elétricas.
  4. Reparo e substituição de componentes: Realizar reparos e substituição de componentes elétricos defeituosos ou danificados, como interruptores, tomadas, lâmpadas, capacitores e motores. Isso pode envolver a desmontagem, reparo, substituição e montagem desses componentes.
  5. Manutenção de sistemas de iluminação: Realizar a manutenção de sistemas de iluminação, incluindo a troca de lâmpadas, reatores e luminárias. Verificar o correto funcionamento dos circuitos de iluminação, realizar medições de luminosidade e tomar medidas para otimizar o consumo de energia.
  6. Interpretação de projetos elétricos: Ler e interpretar projetos elétricos, diagramas e esquemas, para realizar as instalações e manutenções de acordo com as especificações técnicas.
  7. Cumprimento das normas de segurança: Assegurar que todas as atividades sejam realizadas em conformidade com as normas de segurança elétrica, garantindo a utilização adequada de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e a aplicação de práticas seguras de trabalho.

  • NR10 E NR35
  • Residir em Niterói ou São Gonçalo
  • Experiência prévia comprovada como eletrotécnico ou em atividades similares.
  • Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de projetos elétricos e diagramas.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações relacionadas à área elétrica.
  • Habilidades práticas em uso de ferramentas e equipamentos elétricos.
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas e tomar decisões assertivas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
  • Consciência e comprometimento com as normas de segurança elétrica.

description:

19 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Global Head of GSI Alliances role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new senior leadership role, Head of Global System Integrator (GSI) Alliances, to lead our business development and partnership with these important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we are expanding into the enterprise market where GSIs provide significant operational and tactical capacity. We have had good success with GSIs that are delivering next-generation private cloud, container, and public cloud solutions built with Canonical Ubuntu, and are looking to expand our investment in these alliances.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Global Head of GSI Alliances will lead a team of representatives and develop that strategic go-to-market strength for Canonical. You will work closely with GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver opensource solutions at scale for their enterprise customers. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that our solutions are used or embedded at the core of GSI digital transformation platforms.

Our GSI team builds trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increases Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizes the partnership and leads all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. The Global Head of GSI Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all GSI partners, as well as promotion of our GSI related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and GSI related events (including Canonical s yearly GSI executive summit).

Location: Our company largely works from home, this role can be based in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Own and drive GSI partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical
  • Lead and evolve a team towards accelerated revenue growth with GSI
  • Build strategic relationships with partners at executive levels
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

The successful GSI Alliance Sales Director will have :

  • Experience in alliance and indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in the GSI sector
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue and margins
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu and Canonical's competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data-driven decision-making
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

• Colaborar com a equipe de Gestão de Mudanças, oferecendo expertise técnica nas MOCs (Management of Change) para apoiar o contratado do FPSO.

• Oferecer suporte técnico em casos de falhas de equipamentos, interagindo com as equipes de manutenção do contratado do FPSO para troubleshooting e fornecendo recomendações-chave.

• Contribuir nos processos de Análise de Causa Raiz (RCA), fornecendo insights técnicos e recomendações.

• Assegurar a conformidade acompanhando questões de Classificação (Class), regulamentações locais e de bandeira (Flag).

• Garantir, junto ao contratado do FPSO, a execução dos requisitos da norma NR-13.

• Analisar, junto ao contratado do FPSO, a integridade estrutural dos equipamentos em operação, avaliando sua aptidão para continuidade de serviço através de análises de integridade ou inspeção baseada em risco.

• Trabalhar com o contratado do FPSO no desenvolvimento e implementação de análises de modos de falha e efeitos críticos de equipamentos rotativos, análises de causa raiz e falhas, gestão de “bad actors” (ativos com histórico recorrente de falhas) e programas contínuos de melhoria dos equipamentos rotativos.

• Representar a Companhia na preparação de Parada Programada (First Full Shutdown ou paradas gerais), assegurando a segurança e minimização de impactos.

• Liderar projetos para melhorar a confiabilidade do FPSO.

Orçamento

• Apoiar e participar na preparação dos orçamentos de operações.

• Propor e promover ações que conduzam à redução de custos operacionais (OPEX).

• Inovar com soluções digitais que possam reduzir o OPEX.

Sistema de Gestão e Interfaces

• Contribuir para a sustentabilidade do Sistema de Gestão de Operações de Campo (FOMS).

• Garantir as interfaces técnicas com novos projetos e desenvolvimentos, fornecendo feedback técnico.

• Manter intercâmbios frequentes com as entidades da matriz (Headquarters).

Responsabilidades

• HSE : Garantir a conformidade com as diretrizes e regras da Companhia.

• Produção : Otimizar os procedimentos operacionais e fornecer suporte às operações offshore.

• Plano de Trabalho: Contribuir para seu desenvolvimento e implementação, assegurando impacto otimizado na segurança, produção e custos.

• Interface: Coordenar com o pessoal do contratado offshore e com o coordenador onshore da Companhia para garantir a continuidade das operações de campo.

• Custos: Liderar e controlar o orçamento previsto e sua execução, otimizando o OPEX. Promover a conscientização sobre Cultura de Custos.

Formação: Diploma em Engenharia Mecânica ou equivalente.

Experiência Profissional: De 5 a 8 anos de atuação na indústria de Óleo e Gás, com foco nas disciplinas de manutenção e integridade, especialmente em equipamentos rotativos.

Experiência offshore é recomendada.

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.

What You Can Expect

As a senior member of the Brazil Commercial Operations team, this position is responsible for leading all aspects of the Commercial Operations function and its associated team in the country. The role holds full accountability for Demand Planning, Distribution, Customer Service, Inventory Management, and Operational Excellence in Brazil. Working in close partnership with the local Commercial leadership, this position is accountable for achieving functional goals related to customer service levels, forecast accuracy, inventory and asset performance, and for meeting cash flow objectives within the commercial P&L and related cost centers. In support of the Brazil Commercial Head and local business leaders, this role will also drive the use of Integrated Business Planning processes and tools to improve operational performance and cost efficiency, while aligning with the company’s global strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.

How You'll Create Impact

  • Leadership of the regional Supply Chain, Customer Service, Warehousing, Loaner Management and Distribution teams, ensuring SLAs and targets are met, KPIs are in place and all processes and centres are running at optimum efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Work closely with the Executive leadership to develop, propose and execute Customer Centric Supply Chain strategies that support the business and aim to provide competitive advantage in all areas of the Commercial Operations function.
  • Lead and grow Talent, including hiring, advancing, and retaining Talent within own region and in collaboration with the other Functions and HR. Own the regional Talent pool.
  • Own the execution of all Transformation related programs and projects in said area of responsibility as they relate to processes, people, footprint and technology.
  • Assure the delivery of correct Demand Plans that will enable the market to meet sales and service objectives. Own and execute all elements of the IBP process for the region.
  • Maintain high standards of Health & Safety across the region in accordance with the Company’s Health & Safety policy. Ensure departmental procedures support corporate quality & compliance requirements. Perform all activities in compliance with relevant Quality System standards.
  • Support and drive Product Life Cycle management & product rationalization execution to ensure smooth & well communicated market launch and exit of pre-defined product lines.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Life Science and/or Medical Devices industry experience
  • Demonstrated & detailed level of knowledge and understanding of complex global Supply Chains.
  • Ability to operate independently and use judgment for high impact decisions.
  • Ability to simplify a complex supply chain, while considering global & regional tax implications
  • Demonstrated experience successfully leading and engaging teams across multiple locations within region.
  • Demonstrates effective written and oral communication and presentation skills, ability to interact with senior management.
  • Strong analytical skills, along with strong experience with analytics toolsets (Excel, Tableau)
  • Demonstrated Commercial Operations Strategy skills, with an ability to define and implement strategic initiatives
  • Understanding of strategic cost issues and uses range of techniques for cost reduction to meet targets.
  • Strong Financial acumen, with a solid understanding of Financial Statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash-Flows)
  • Ability to engage in contract negotiations and develop contracts on a national or regional basis; create basic project plans and manger source plan and implementation across functions and sites.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in job related functional area.
  • Conflict resolution, people development, delegation, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Strong background in process and change management.

Your Background

  • Excellent command of English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Over 10 years of relevant experience in similar operations roles, including proven leadership in operations management.
  • Preferably experienced in MedTech, ideally in orthopedics; however, backgrounds in other medical device areas (e.g., neuro) are also valued.
  • Strong financial acumen, with hands-on experience managing P&L, balance sheets, cash flow, and cost centers.
  • Proficiency with advanced supply chain systems and technologies (e.g., SAP, APO, or similar platforms).

Travel Expectations

description:

Descrição:

Descrição e Responsabilidades

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações.

Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos.

CONTEXTO DA VAGA:

A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa.

COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL:

Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras.

Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana , abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo.

É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa.

Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você!

COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

  • Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo) , apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF;
  • Preservar a imagem de MSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação;
  • Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores.

Requisitos:

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

• Português fluente;

• Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação;

• Pacote Office básico.

O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

• Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor.

QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

  • Gerenciamento de estresse pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma;
  • Capacidade de negociação para comunicar aos outros os seus próprios objetivos e demandas;
  • Iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades e problemas;
  • Flexibilidade comportamental para adaptar comportamentos as necessidades da situação.

Venha fazer parte da Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!

PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 01/07/2025

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno.

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.

We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.

Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.

An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.

You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.

This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.

Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team

What we are looking for in you

  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Pyyne

Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Microsoft Migration Specialist for a contractor position to lead a large-scale migration from Google Workspace (Gmail) to Microsoft 365 for one of our enterprise clients in the insurance sector.

This role is pivotal to ensuring a seamless and secure transition of email, calendars, contacts, and collaboration tools to the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Google-to-Microsoft migrations and be comfortable working in enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and complex dependencies.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Planning & Execution:

  • Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of the Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration.

  • Execute migrations of mail, calendars, contacts, and files using best-in-class tools and methodologies.
  • Utilize tools such as BitTitan MigrationWiz or Google Workspace Migration for Microsoft Exchange (GWMME).

Cloud Integration & Configuration:

  • Set up and configure Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Establish user accounts, mail flow rules, retention policies, and security configurations.
  • Manage identity synchronization with Azure Active Directory and configure appropriate access policies.

Troubleshooting & Support:

  • Identify and resolve data transfer issues, permission conflicts, and post-migration inconsistencies.
  • Serve as an escalation point during and after the migration to ensure minimal business disruption.
  • Document procedures and provide training or handoff support to internal IT teams.

Stakeholder Communication:

  • Work closely with client IT teams, project managers, and business stakeholders to ensure clarity and alignment throughout the project.
  • Provide regular updates, status reports, and risk assessments during the project lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience & Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise IT, including at least 2 successful migrations from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.
  • In-depth knowledge of:
  • Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 configuration.
  • Google Workspace admin console and architecture.
  • Identity and access management via Azure AD.
  • Migration tools like BitTitan, GWMME, or CloudMigrator.
Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and troubleshooting.Strong understanding of security, compliance, and email archiving best practices in Microsoft 365.

Soft Skills:

  • Ability to lead and manage large-scale projects independently.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a user-focused mindset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

Location:

  • Remote-first

The Ideal Candidate

 You are a technically strong, execution-oriented migration expert with specific experience moving enterprise clients from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365. You enjoy working in dynamic environments and understand the importance of a seamless user experience during complex transitions. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and confident in taking ownership of end-to-end delivery.

Benefits

  • Competitive hourly contractor rate based on experience.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a business-critical migration for a major insurance organization.
  • Potential for future engagements with Pyyne’s expanding enterprise client portfolio

Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer - packaging - optimize Ubuntu Server role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical's Ubuntu Engineering Server Team is looking for open source enthusiasts to help build the distro of the future. The Server Team maintains and packages a wide variety of software including webservers, databases, and virtualization and containerization stacks. This is an exciting opportunity for you, a software engineer passionate about open source software. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company and help us to bring free software to the widest audience.

Ubuntu Server is a platform that enables amazing technology the whole world over, and is the #1 operating system in the public clouds. Applicants to this role will have the opportunity to help with everything that goes into evolving Ubuntu. You will get to work with our experienced team and have the benefits of learning and growing alongside the best engineers in the business.

The role entails

  • Collaborating proactively within a distributed team
  • Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users
  • Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards.
  • Playing a role in shaping the future of Ubuntu via both - new ideas in your areas of interest and advising on work being done elsewhere
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers
  • Owning the maintenance of Ubuntu Server packages. Specifically but not limited to:
  • Traditional server workloads (web servers, databases, network services, etc)
  • Virtualisation and Containers
  • Package management and dependencies
  • Language runtimes and toolchains
Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Interest or experience in open source maintenance or contributions
  • Able to replay complex workloads and systems. Able to write detailed test plans and reproducibility steps.
  • Feel comfortable contributing and debugging many languages such as C/C++, Python, Rust, Go, Ruby, PHP
  • Experience in packaging in one or more ecosystems. This could be language specific systems (Python wheels, Rust Crates, Go Modules, or other equivalent) or any distro package format (deb, rpm, NixOS, or other equivalent).
  • Experience using and creating containers and virtual machines
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree (or any higher) or equivalent professional experience (5+ years of professional experience)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Oficial de Manutenção I - Centro
description:
**Oportunidade de Carreira na Álamo Engenharia S/A**

Estamos em busca de um Oficial de Manutenção I para se juntar à nossa equipe em um dos nossos clientes no centro do Rio de Janeiro.

Este é um papel fundamental para garantir que nossos projetos de engenharia sejam concluídos com excelência técnica e eficiência operacional.

Como Oficial de Manutenção I, você será responsável por supervisionar e executar tarefas de manutenção em diversas áreas de nossas operações, garantindo a funcionalidade e a segurança dos equipamentos e instalações.

Você será parte de uma equipe dedicada e colaborativa, onde sua atenção aos detalhes e habilidades técnicas serão essenciais para o sucesso.

Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão a execução de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, inspeção e reparo de equipamentos, e manutenção de registros técnicos.

Além disso, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com engenheiros e técnicos para garantir que todos os projetos sejam concluídos dentro dos prazos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.

Experiência prévia em manutenção industrial ou áreas relacionadas é altamente valorizada.

Conhecimento em normas de segurança e procedimentos de manutenção, além de curso de elétrica predial ou industrial com no mínimo 120h, é essencial.

Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, além de habilidades de resolução de problemas e organização, são características desejadas.

Junte-se à Álamo Engenharia S/A e faça parte de uma equipe que se dedica a inovar e aprimorar continuamente os padrões de excelência em engenharia.

Se você tem paixão por manutenção e deseja contribuir para projetos de engenharia de alto nível, esta é uma oportunidade para você.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde
Sobre a Álamo Engenharia S/A

Com mais de 50 anos no setor de manutenção e facilities, a Álamo Engenharia é reconhecida por ampliar seus horizontes e trabalhar focada nas pessoas. Fundada em 1970, a empresa iniciou prestando serviços como consultora em projetos de alta qualificação técnica para o desenvolvimento de infraestruturas. Com foco na qualidade e agilidade, a empresa expandiu sua carteira de clientes, tornando-se referência em engenharia de manutenção predial e industrial.

Com mais de 2.000 funcionários, somos uma empresa sólida e dinâmica, comprometida com nossas pessoas, clientes e sociedade. Atuamos em todo o Brasil, oferecendo aos gestores e administradores um pacote completo de manutenção de instalações.

A gestão de ESG da Álamo inclui ações e práticas que promovem uma sociedade mais inclusiva e diversa, gerando valor por meio de ações sociais responsáveis que impactam positivamente a comunidade, colaboradores, parceiros e o meio ambiente.

description:
Embedded Linux Field Engineering ManagerJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager

2 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

The role entails

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are seeking to hire a General Counsel for the Latin America & Caribbean (CALA) region who will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day legal aspects of PTI’s business in CALA. Specific area of focus includes overseeing tower real estate holdings including underlying ground lease management, ongoing improvements to ground leases, oversight of land and tower acquisitions, customer contracts, loan compliance, personnel management and managing the corporate governance of the Group companies in CALA. The GC will provide effective advice on Company strategies and their implementation, manage the day-to-day legal function of the business, and oversee the work of outside counsels. Other responsibilities include negotiating, writing, reviewing, summarizing, researching, and executing a wide variety of agreements for the company. Furthermore, the CALA General Counsel will work collaboratively with the Global General Counsel and the Company’s international counsel to oversee and implement best practices in connection with all legal aspects of the business.

LOCATION: The location of the role is flexible and can be based in a region where PTI has an office in one of the CALA markets.

Functions

  • Responsible for day-to-day legal operations across CALA leading a team of 40+ experienced lawyers across the Region and ensuring alignment with company objectives and legal best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with local laws, corporate governance & filings, and international regulations, including FCPA
  • Negotiate various types of agreements and review contracts, including but not limited to: agreements with customers for the lease of space in PTI’s infrastructures; vendor contracts; contracts related to the lease of land and space in telecommunications infrastructure, as well as regarding construction, sale, and usufruct projects of properties and wireless infrastructure including; master lease agreements, site lease agreements, ground lease agreements; built-to-suit agreements, new tower development agreements, among others
  • Provide assistance to the M&A and Financing teams on all major business transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, and joint ventures.
  • Coordinate with international counsels to implement consistent legal standards and practices.
  • Provide legal guidance to internal stakeholders across business units.
  • Represent PTI Legal at Board Meetings in local markets.
  • Assist in the preparation of, and revisions to, standard forms and PTI template agreements.
  • Assist the Asset Management, Lease Administration, and Ground Lease Buyout Departments with legal advice and documents that are required.
  • Oversee the preparation of corporate documents required in the CALA region and maintain Company’s legal files for the region.
  • Serve as liaison with local external lawyers and represent the Company before counterparts, local lawyers, and operators.
  • Exercise other duties or functions as required in the capacity of legal counsel to the Company.

These job functions are representative of tasks accomplished by incumbents. The list is not exhaustive; incumbents perform other related tasks.

Working Conditions And Physical Demands

Position works in a standard office environment. Standing, sitting, and walking required daily.

Qualifications

  • Law degree (equivalent to JD) from an accredited university. Master’s degree in related area.
  • Must be licensed and authorized to practice law in the country of residence.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in corporate and real estate law; experience in the telecommunications and/or tower industry is preferred.
  • Must have in-house legal experience and oversight.
  • Demonstrated legal experience within the Latin America region, with a strong understanding of regional legal, regulatory and business environments.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Proven leadership experience managing teams of legal professionals and cross-functional projects required.
  • Highly polished and effective negotiation, communication and drafting skills.
  • Self-starter with initiative and demonstrated creative problem-solving ability.
  • Pragmatic and business-focused mindset with demonstrated ability to take ownership and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to independently lead and direct its staff to execute all facets of challenging transactional engagements.
  • Strong judgment and proven ability to work collaboratively with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, flexible culture.
  • Strong work ethic, well-organized, and detail oriented.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno - DevOps
description:
Sua Missão como Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno - DevOps será:

  1. Integração contínua/entrega contínua (CI/CD): desenho e manutenção de pipelines em Jenkins, GitLabCI, GitHubActions ou AzureDevOps, com gates de qualidade, testes automatizados e artefatos versionados.
  2. Containerização e orquestração: criação de imagens Docker/Podman, deployment e troubleshooting em Kubernetes/OpenShift/EKS, utilização de Helm e Kustomize.
  3. Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): provisionamento idempotente com Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation ou Pulumi; criação de módulos reutilizáveis e pipelines de validação.
  4. Cloud computing: projeto e operação de workloads em AWS, Azure ou GCP (EC2/VMs, VPC/VNet, IAM, serviços gerenciados, escalonamento automático e otimização de custos).
  5. Observabilidade: coleta de métricas (Prometheus), logs (ELK/EFK), tracing (OpenTelemetry) e dashboards em Grafana; definição de SLIs/SLOs e alertas (Alertmanager).
  6. Scripting e automação: Bash, PowerShell e Python para provisionamento, health-check, relatórios e integração de APIs REST.
  7. Gestão de configuração: Ansible, Puppet ou Chef para padronizar ambientes on-premise e cloud, com enfoque em idempotência e drift detection.
  8. Versionamento e revisão de código: Git (GitFlow, trunk-based), pull requests, code review e integração de scanners de qualidade estática (SonarQube).
  9. Metodologias ágeis e cultura DevOps: Scrum/Kanban, Lean IT, práticas de colaboração (ChatOps), planejamento de sprint e retrospectivas focadas em melhoria contínua.
  10. Segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps): scans de vulnerabilidade em imagens, SCA, políticas de segurança em pipelines e gestão de secrets (Vault, AWSSecretsManager).

Por Isso, Esperamos Que Você Possua:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento específicos em DevOps.
  • Inglês Intermediário.

Ao Embarcar Na Omni Você Terá:

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Wellhub / Total Pass
  • Parceria Open English

  • Conhecimento básico sobre processos de refino, transferência e estocagem de petróleo e derivados.

Junte-se à Sudamin e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma desafios em soluções.

title: Gerente de contas jr
description:
Sobre a vaga

Estamos à procura de um Gerente de Contas dinâmico e proativo para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este profissional será responsável por manter o crescimento e o sucesso de nossas operações comerciais, gerenciar a carteira de clientes, construir relacionamentos com clientes e com representantes, identificar oportunidades de vendas e assegurar a satisfação dos clientes. Suas principais funções incluem a análise de históricos de vendas, gaps ou oportunidades por área, a cobrança de desempenho dos representantes comerciais, atividades de pós-venda, a prospecção de novos clientes e de representantes comerciais. Além disso, será o guardião dos resultados de vendas, assegurando que as metas da empresa sejam alcançadas. Esta posição não é executiva e exige habilidades de negociação, comunicação e um forte foco em resultados.

Principais Atividades:

  1. Contato com Clientes: Manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes, atendendo suas necessidades e promovendo nossos produtos.
  2. Suporte aos Representantes: Atender aos representantes, dando suporte às demandas.
  3. Análise de Histórico de Vendas e Faturamento: Analisar dados de vendas e faturamento para identificar tendências, oportunidades e áreas de melhoria.
  4. Gestão de Resultados: Fazer a avaliação das vendas da empresa, sugerindo ações proativas para atingir e superar as metas definidas.
  5. Identificação de Oportunidades: Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de vendas dentro da carteira de clientes existente, além de explorar novas contas potenciais e oportunidades de novos produtos.
  6. Prospecção de Novos Clientes: Buscar ativamente novos clientes e oportunidades de negócio para expandir a base de clientes, desenvolvendo estratégias e fomentando a qualidade dos produtos.
  7. Busca de Novos Representantes: Identificar, recrutar e integrar novos representantes comerciais à equipe.
  8. Cobrança de Desempenho: Monitorar e cobrar o desempenho dos representantes comerciais, garantindo o cumprimento de metas e objetivos, conduzindo resultados com os mesmos, além de demandar abertura de novas áreas/regiões.
  9. Pós-Venda: Realizar atividades de pós-venda, assegurando a satisfação do cliente e a resolução de eventuais problemas.
  10. Gestão de Carteira de Clientes: Manter e gerenciar a carteira de clientes, garantindo um relacionamento positivo e produtivo.
  11. Colaboração Interna: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Suporte Comercial, PCP e Operação, para atender às expectativas dos clientes e da empresa.

Experiência

A partir de 3 anos em gestão de contas, venda, atendimento ao cliente, relacionamento com representantes e gestão de resultados. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e análise de dados são essenciais. Experiência em prospecção de novos clientes e representantes e uso de ferramentas de CRM é desejável. Foco em resultados e capacidade de construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e representantes.

Conhecimento Técnico

Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas. Pacote Office intermediário. Técnicas de negociação. Conhecimento em ferramentas de buscas de clientes e representantes. Conhecimentos de CRM ou outros sistemas. Análise de mercado.

Habilidades Requeridas (Soft Skills)

Habilidade avançada de comunicação verbal e escrita, com desenvoltura. Capacidade crítica e analítica. Ser criativo. Ser organizado e gostar de trabalhar com processos. Alto nível de resiliência, saber trabalhar sob pressão. Saber e gostar de trabalhar em equipe, respeitando as diferenças. Ser persuasivo e ter forte habilidade de negociação. Saber contornar objeções sem parecer insistente. Ser emocionalmente inteligente. Seriedade que o cargo exige. Ter pontualidade. Dinamismo e proatividade.

Local de Trabalho e Carga Horária

Segunda a Quinta - De 7:15 às 17hs; Sexta - De 7:15 às 16hs; Pavuna, RJ; Disponibilidade para eventuais viagens.

Remuneração:

Salário + Remuneração Variável
